added.heading: You were added to {workspace}
added.reason: You got this email because a server admin of {site} added this address. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore it.
added.subject: You were added to {workspace} on {site}
added.text: {who} added you to {workspace} on {site} as {role}: answer and follow up on the calls its assistant takes.
addedNotice.reason: You got this email because a server admin of {site} added you. If you didn't expect it, tell the workspace's owner.
addedToWorkspace.note: The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Enter this email address on the sign-in page and we send you a code.
addedToWorkspace.preheader: {inviter} added you as {role}. Sign in with this address to join.
adminAlert.reason: You got this email because you are a server admin of {site}. Every server admin gets these alerts.
assigned.reason: You got this email because a teammate in {workspace} assigned you a call.
assigned.subject: {by} assigned you a call: {topic}
booking.change: To change or cancel it, call {business} at {phone}.
booking.changeBack: To change or cancel it, call {business} back.
booking.heading: Your {what} is booked
booking.reason: You got this email because you booked by phone with {business} and gave this address.
booking.subject: Confirmed: your {what} with {business}, {when}
call.reason: You get one email per call to {workspace}.
call.recording: The recording and the transcript are in {brand}.
call.subject: {topic} · {from}
code.note: It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Don't share this code: nobody from {brand} or your team will ever ask you for it.
confirmationCode.heading: Your confirmation code
confirmationCode.note: It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Don't share this code with anyone; {brand} staff will never ask for it.
confirmationCode.preheader: It confirms this address for your {brand} account at {site}.
confirmationCode.reason: You got this email because your account asked to confirm this address. If it wasn't you, you can ignore it.
confirmationCode.subject: {code} is your {brand} confirmation code
confirmationCode.text: This code confirms this address for your {brand} account at {site}. Enter it on {site}, where {brand} asked for it.
emailChangeCode.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChangeCode.preheader: Enter it in Account settings on {site} to sign in with this address from now on.
emailChangeCode.reason: You got this email because someone signed in to {brand} on {site} asked to use this address for their account. If it wasn't you, you can ignore it: nothing changes without this code.
emailChangeCode.subject: {code} is your {brand} code to change your email
emailChangeCode.text: Enter this code in Account settings on {site}. Your {brand} account then uses this address to sign in and for its emails.
emailChangeConfirm.heading: Confirm it's you
emailChangeConfirm.preheader: Someone signed in to your account on {site} wants to change its email address.
emailChangeConfirm.reason: You got this email because it is the address of your account. If it wasn't you, don't enter the code: change your password and tell your administrator.
emailChangeConfirm.subject: {code} is your {brand} code to confirm it's you
emailChangeConfirm.text: Someone signed in to your {brand} account on {site} wants to change its email address. Enter this code in Account settings to confirm it's you.
emailChangeRefused.heading: This address can't be used
emailChangeRefused.note: If that was you, use a different address, or sign in with this one instead. If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
emailChangeRefused.preheader: Someone asked to move their account to this address. Nothing was changed.
emailChangeRefused.reason: You got this email because this address was entered as a new sign-in address. We always send it.
emailChangeRefused.subject: This address can't be used for another {brand} account
emailChangeRefused.text: Someone signed in to {brand} on {site} asked to use this address for their account. It already belongs to an account there or is kept for a server admin, so it can't be used for another one, and nothing was changed.
emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.notYou: If it was not you, someone has access to your account: tell your administrator right away, so they can turn the account off.
emailChanged.preheader: Your account now signs in with {email}.
emailChanged.reason: You got this email because it was the address of your account until now. We always send it.
emailChanged.subject: The email of your {brand} account was changed
emailChanged.text: Your {brand} account at {site} now uses {email} to sign in and for its emails, and its other sessions were signed out. This address no longer signs in to it.
enterAddress: Enter this email address on the sign-in page and we send you a code.
firstCall.heading: Your first call
firstCall.reason: From now on you get one email per call to {workspace}.
firstCall.subject: Your first real call · {from}
firstCall.text: The first real call to {workspace} just came in.
firstCall.textTitle: The first real call to {workspace} just came in: {title}.
invitation.note: The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Sign in with this address ({email}): enter it on the sign-in page and we email you a code.
invitation.preheader: {inviter} invited you. The invitation is open for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
invitation.reason: You got this email because someone invited this address. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore it.
invitation.subject: Join {workspace} on {brand}
invitation.text: {inviter} invited you to join {workspace} on {brand} at {site}: answer and follow up on the calls its assistant takes.
memberAdded.check: If you didn't expect this, check the team and remove them there.
memberAdded.heading: {who} was added to {workspace}
memberAdded.pending: They join once they confirm their email address.
memberAdded.reason: You got this email because you own {workspace}, and a server admin of {site} changed its team. We always send it.
memberAdded.subject: {admin} added {who} to {workspace}
passkeyChanged.heading: {change, select, added {A passkey was added} other {A passkey was removed}}
passkeyChanged.notYou: If it wasn't you, ask a server admin of your {brand} to remove all passkeys of your account (Server admin › Users, your name, Reset passkeys), then sign in and add your own again.
passkeyChanged.subject: {change, select, added {A passkey was added to} other {A passkey was removed from}} your {brand} account
passkeyChanged.text: {change, select, added {A passkey was added to} other {A passkey was removed from}} your {brand} account at {site}.
passkeyEnrolment.next: Get the code from them, then add your passkey under Account settings › Sign-in & security.
passkeyEnrolment.preheader: Use it to add your first passkey. Nothing else changed.
passkeyEnrolment.text: {issuedBy} issued a one-time code for the first passkey of your {brand} account. Nothing was removed and you are still signed in.
passkeyEnrolment.unexpected: If you did not ask for this, tell the other administrators of {brand} at once: whoever has the code can add a passkey to your account.
passkeysReset.heading: {kind, select, removed {Your passkeys were removed} other {Passkey enrolment code issued}}
passkeysReset.next: Sign in with an email code or your password, then add a new passkey under Account settings › Sign-in & security.
passkeysReset.preheader: Sign in again, then add a new passkey.
passkeysReset.subject: {kind, select, removed {The passkeys of your {brand} account were removed} other {A passkey enrolment code was issued for your {brand} account}}
passkeysReset.text: {kind, select, removed {A server admin removed every passkey of your {brand} account and signed you out everywhere.} other {A server admin issued a passkey enrolment code for your {brand} account and signed you out everywhere.}}
passkeysReset.unexpected: If you did not ask for this, tell your administrator.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.notYou: If it was not you, someone can read your email: secure your mailbox first, then use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page to set a new password, and tell your administrator.
passwordChanged.subject: The password of your {brand} account was changed
passwordChanged.text: The password of your {brand} account at {site} was reset with a code sent to this address, and you were signed out everywhere.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.preheader: Enter it on the sign-in page of {site} to set a new password. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
passwordReset.reason: You got this email because someone asked to reset the password for this address on {site}. If it wasn't you, you can ignore it: your password stays the same.
passwordReset.subject: {code} is your {brand} password reset code
passwordReset.text: Enter this code on the {brand} sign-in page at {site}, then choose a new password.
role.inSentence: {role, select, owner {an owner} admin {an admin} other {a member}}
security.nothingToDo: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
security.reason: You got this email because the sign-in methods of your account changed. We always send it.
setup.day0HeadingCall: Try it with a real call
setup.day0Subject: {assistant} is almost ready to answer for {workspace}
setup.day0Text: {assistant} is set up for {workspace}. One thing is left before callers reach {assistant}:
setup.day1Subject: {assistant} hasn't answered a real call yet
setup.day3Subject: Still one step before {assistant} answers your calls
setup.nudgeText: No real calls have reached {assistant} yet. The one thing left:
setup.partner: Rather have someone do it for you? A partner can set up {brand} for {workspace}, phone settings included.
setup.reason: You get a few emails while {workspace} gets set up. They stop once {assistant} answers real calls.
setup.stepCallAll: Call your business number from a phone that isn't one of yours (a friend's): {assistant} answers.
setup.stepCallMissed: Call your business number from a phone that isn't one of yours (a friend's) and let it ring. When you don't pick up, {assistant} does.
setup.stepForwardAll: If you haven't yet, forward your business line to {to}. The steps for your phone company are in {brand}.
setup.stepForwardMissed: If you haven't yet, forward the calls you don't pick up on your business line to {to}. The steps for your phone company are in {brand}.
setup.stepNumber: Pick a phone number for {assistant}. It takes a minute in {brand}.
signInCode.heading: Your sign-in code
signInCode.preheader: Enter it on the sign-in page of {site}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
signInCode.reason: You got this email because someone asked to sign in to {site} with this address. If it wasn't you, you can ignore it.
signInCode.subject: {code} is your {brand} sign-in code
signInCode.text: Enter this code on the {brand} sign-in page at {site}.
week.heading: Your first week
week.preheader: {assistant} answered {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} in the first week.
week.reason: You get this once, a week after {workspace} got its owner.
week.subject: {assistant}'s first week at {workspace}
week.text: In its first week, {assistant} answered {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} for {workspace}.
welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
welcome.preheader: Sign in at {site} with this address.
welcome.reason: You got this email because a server admin of {site} added you.
welcome.subject: Your {brand} account is ready
welcome.text: A server admin created a {brand} account for you at {site}.
workspaceDeleted.accountDeleted: Your {brand} account at {site} was deleted with it, because you belonged to no other workspace. You can't sign in there anymore.
workspaceDeleted.accountKept: Your account and your other workspaces stay as they are.
workspaceDeleted.heading: {workspace} was deleted
workspaceDeleted.reason: You got this email because you were a member of {workspace} on {site}. We always send it.
workspaceDeleted.subject: {workspace} was deleted on {brand}
workspaceDeleted.text: {by} deleted the workspace {workspace} on {when}. Its calls, contacts, recordings and settings are gone, and nobody can open it anymore.
workspaceDeleted.unexpected: If you didn't expect this, ask the workspace owner.
workspaceRemoved.accountDeleted: Your {brand} account at {site} was deleted too, because you belonged to no other workspace. You can't sign in there anymore.
workspaceRemoved.heading: You were removed from {workspace}
workspaceRemoved.subject: You were removed from {workspace} on {brand}
workspaceRemoved.text: {by} removed you from the workspace {workspace} on {when}. You no longer have access to its calls, contacts and settings.
workspaceRemoved.unexpected: If you didn't expect this, ask the workspace owner for a new invitation.
